title: Platypus UV Light Biofluorescence Secret
idea: Platypus glows blue-green under UV light due to biofluorescence

lines.text: Kya aapko pata hai ki platypus andhere mein chamakta hai?
Yeh anokha jeev ultraviolet light ke neeche striking blue-green color mein glow karta hai.
Inke is unique fur ki biofluorescence scientist ko bhi hairan kar deti hai.
Inke is chote se waterproof body par dense brown fur hota hai.
Inka yeh hair coat aur fur predators se bachne ke liye madad karta hai.
Kya aapne kabhi kisi aise anokhe mammal ko dekha hai? Comment karo!
